//: Firebase Hosting config for the recruitment page. The club site lives in its own repo and its own Hosting site; this deploys alongside it in the same project. Firebase does not read public/_headers, so the same header list is repeated here. Change one, change both.

rewrites.//: Single page app. Every path serves index.html so a refresh on a deep link does not 404. The form uses a hash for its step, so this mostly matters for anyone who mistypes a path.

headers.//: script-src has no 'unsafe-inline' because the Vite build emits no inline scripts. style-src needs it because React sets element style attributes. connect-src must name the Supabase project or every submission is blocked before it leaves the browser.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'

headers.//: Matches both / and /index.html. Firebase serves the app at /, and a rule for the literal path alone left the root on the default max-age=3600, so a returning visitor could get an hour-old page after a deploy. On a launch day with fixes going out, that is the difference between shipping a fix and thinking you have.
